role: Previously consumed full-match provider-flag diagnostic; not an untouched holdout or challenge score.
comparison: Frozen selected exit-only decoder versus official known-live home/away flags and raw nearest-player attribution on identical frames.

external_metrica_game1_crosscheck.source: Corrected 25-fps clean/no-tag exit-only model; censored provider-known live frames, not challenge possession truth.
external_metrica_game1_crosscheck.interpretation: The large DFL fast-near versus fast-far contrast does not reproduce on Metrica Game 1; do not select a speed/proximity gate from a consumed provider match.

interpretation: Raw nearest-player error during fast and distant flight is not a selected-model error; the temporal decoder is already 88.2% correct there. DFL fast-near accuracy is lower, but the split does not repeat on Metrica. Provider flags are not independently reviewed physical touches, and earlier contact-motion/owner-flight prototypes failed high-IoU or masked-recovery guards.
decision: No blanket flight-owner prior, no DFL-fitted fast-near gate, and no new challenge submission. Obtain independent physical-touch evidence or a predeclared source-only cue that passes external Game 1 and frozen transfer guards before modifying the selected exit-only model.
